notes.title: UPDATE V4.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A new update has come for Home Design 3D!
You can find more details about this version 4.3 HERE

Features

 Multi-selection feature! You can select several items and move them around at the same time, copy the group of same objects in one move
 New project menu: improved interface to easily manage your projects. Select several projects and save/share them at the same time
 Improved ergonomics with written feedbacks


Additional content
 New interface: modern and elegant
 Snap feature improved by snapping object to another object
 New objects including many stairs designs!
 General optimization and bug fix

We hope you will enjoy this update. Feel free to share your feedback!

- The Home Design 3D Team

notes.title: UPDATE 4.1.1 - PRINT 3D
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

The new update 4.1.1 is online! It brings many big changes and a new feature!

3D printing Color service

As 3D printing technology is going more and more important in the interior design field, we notice that it is only accessible to a few. With this new Home Design 3D feature, this technology is now available to anyone, no need to have a 3D printer at home, or to contact a specialized company. 

Create a project in Home Design 3D, click on the 3D Printer Icon, visualize the virtual 3D printed model of your project then choose a scale. Enter your info, validate your order and receive it at home! 

All our 3D printed models are made from  high professional quality printers in color, thanks to the ColorJet Printing (CJP) technology. Before any printing, an operator/infographist checks the 3D model and adjusts it if necessary. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10881986/4971b13572d9afe3473cb5f84364fdb4c2f1e3a0.png

Click on the 3D Printer Icon at the right of the main bar menu and see by yourself :). 

Other new changes:

    +130 new objects, including cars! 
    New advanced graphical parameters --> 'Gear' icon
    Help section improved: better pages, contents, video tutorials --> '?' icon
    Bug fixes

notes.title: UPDATE 11/30/2016
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

An update is available. It especially contains the share feature on the Online Gallery! 

Indeed, when you create a project, you can now share it with the community. Inspire yourself from other users' projects, home designs etc.   
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10881986/198f7ead1dc7a9855d3039daa365cdb516d0ca99.png
Take a look at the recent gallery projects)

The update also contains:
- An improvement of the color wheel.
- Multiple improvements of the 2D edition.
- Fixing problems with the magnetism.
- Fixing bugs with some objects that couldn't be placed outside of rooms and lands. 

Don't hesitate to warn us if you encounter any problem :)

Have fun designing! :) 

The Home Design 3D Team

notes.title: [11/17/2016] Major update Version 4.0
notes.notes:
Please notice that starting with this version Windows 32 bits support is dropped.

Significative changes:

  New user interface
  Render engine improvements:
  
    Optimizations
    Shadow maps
    Cell shading post effect
    SAO post effect
    Fixes and improvements on the lighting
  
  Copy/Past of objects
  Project sharing : export in hd3d file
  Integrated capture feature
  Color chart to customize textures
  Adding the plot tracing tool
  Major refactoring on how we update the architecture


More information about the architecture refactoring:
This refactoring helps us to fix a lot of small issues and allow us to make some optimizations. It will also be a good base to add floors.

Other changes (some aren't listed):

  Integration of crash reporting of steam 
  Crash at startup on "Nvidia Optimus" and "Amd Power Xpress" should be fixed
  Memory consumption and performances improvement
  Improvement of numerous objects (We are still working on adding new objects and improving their quality)
  Application should start faster
  New default projects
  Cotations marking the distance between objects are editable (We have some other projects to improve the edition)
  Swimming pool are now doing a hole in the ground
  Language selection can be switch in game properties from your steam library
  Adding texture import
  Adding object's height scale
  Eyedropper tool to find a used material

notes.title: UPDATE 04/22/16
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We know that some of you have crashes issues when opening a project. This occurs when you are using a portable computer with multiple graphic cards.
We have pinned a message here.

Meanwhile in this update we have integrated the Steamworks Error Reporting.

In general it will give us feedbacks on bugs, errors and crashes. We will also be able to identify which graphic cards cause issues. 

Home Design 3D Team
